name: Teamwork
description: Great leaders foster collaboration, build trust within teams, and leverage diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals.
questions: Tell me about a time when you worked with a cross-functional team to deliver a project. What was your role and how did you contribute?
Describe a situation where you had a disagreement with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
Give me an example of when you helped a colleague who was struggling with their workload. What did you do?
Tell me about a time when you had to build consensus among team members with different opinions.
Describe a project where effective teamwork led to a better outcome than any individual could have achieved alone.

name: Problem Solving
description: Effective problem solvers analyze situations thoroughly, consider multiple approaches, and implement creative solutions under constraints.
questions: Tell me about a complex problem you solved at work. What was your approach?
Describe a time when you had to make a decision with incomplete information. What did you do?
Give me an example of when you identified a problem before it became critical. How did you address it?
Tell me about a time when your first solution to a problem didn't work. What did you do next?
Describe a situation where you had to balance multiple constraints to find a workable solution.

name: Communication
description: Strong communicators convey ideas clearly, listen actively, and adapt their message to different audiences.
questions: Tell me about a time when you had to explain a complex technical concept to a non-technical audience.
Describe a situation where miscommunication led to a problem. How did you fix it?
Give me an example of when you had to deliver difficult feedback to someone. How did you approach it?
Tell me about a time when you had to persuade stakeholders to support your idea.
Describe a situation where active listening helped you understand a problem better.

name: Adaptability
description: Adaptable professionals embrace change, learn quickly from new situations, and maintain effectiveness when priorities shift.
questions: Tell me about a time when project requirements changed significantly midway through. How did you adapt?
Describe a situation where you had to learn a new skill or technology quickly to complete a task.
Give me an example of when you had to adjust your working style to collaborate with someone different from you.
Tell me about a time when you faced an unexpected setback. How did you recover?
Describe a situation where you had to reprioritize your work on short notice. What was the impact?
